meta.reference: v301 G2_b26 must give monthly_dev4 6.527 and dev DD 17.33
meta.episode_def: 4h-close equity (path_out eq, indexed by bar close T) sliced to dev; running peak/cummax; dd=1-eq/peak; scan for dd>0.07; extend while dd>0; trough=argmax dd in segment; peak=argmax eq up to trough; window=(peak,trough] for sums.
meta.book_sleeve_def: attrib (t, per-asset book array, sleeve) as fractions of bar-start equity; sums over window bars (t>peak & t<=trough).
meta.sleeve_coin_def: per-coin sleeve = sum(ret*weight) of rung_tp/sl/timeout exits with peak<t_exit<=trough.
meta.top3_def: book: 3 worst single-bar total-book attrib sums in the window, share of book_sum; rungs: rung exits grouped by exit 4h bar, 3 worst bars' share of sleeve_sum; combined: 3 worst total-bar (book+sleeve attrib) share of total loss. Shares reported only when the denominator is negative.
meta.flush_def: rung_sl grouped by floor-4h bar of exit time; systemic flush = bar with >=3 stopped rungs of >=3 distinct coins.
meta.exposure_def: bars[i].target per coin (fraction of equity, governor included); gross=sum|tgt|, net=sum(tgt); top decile = 90th percentile of |net| over dev bars; daily eod net = last bar.
meta.a_def: BTC 4h vol = rolling std(42) of BTC 4h-open returns on the decision grid; threshold = 80th percentile of the past 540 vols excluding the current bar; risk_mult 0.5/1.0 (governor; scales book targets and sleeve sizes).
meta.b_def: skip a rung fill at minute f when >=3 rungs of other coins (symbol != current) in the same holding bar already stopped with exit minute < f (causal; engine copy).
meta.c_def: per-bar sleeve budget 0.26, cut to 0.13 when eq[i-2] is >6% below its trailing 540-bar peak (2-bar lag like the governor; engine copy).
post_hoc_changes: after the first run: attribute peak->recovery as well as peak->trough. Reason: the 2024-08-05 systemic flush (-12.6% sleeve exits in 2 bars, 4h-close dd 10.6% on 2024-08-05) and the 2024-09-20 8.6% local trough sit in ep9's recovery leg (dd never reset to 0 between 2024-07-16 and Oct), so peak->trough-only windows orphan the largest flush. Added recovery_date, peak->recovery book/sleeve sums, and recovery-leg max dd per episode. Episode peak/trough/depth/days definitions unchanged.
